# NextGen Analytics
> AI-Powered Data Analytics & Automation Agency. We build Power BI Dashboards, AI Lead Generators, and Custom CRMs.
> We build AI-powered systems that solve real business problems. We listen to your problem, then build the best solution with FastAPI + React + AI and deliver it fast. CRM + ERP + Delivery - all in one system.

## About NextGen Analytics
NextGen Analytics is a solo-founded AI and Data Analytics agency led by Muhammad Affaf. We specialize in turning messy, manual business processes into automated, AI-driven systems. From interactive Business Intelligence dashboards to end-to-end SaaS products, we deliver full-stack solutions that save time and drive revenue. We are based in Karachi, Pakistan, and serve clients globally.

## Our Core Services
1. **Business Intelligence & Data Analytics:** 
   - Custom Power BI dashboards, DAX optimization, SQL data pipelines.
   - Sales, Inventory, HR, and Real Estate analytics.
2. **AI Automation & LLM Chatbots:**
   - Custom AI tools using OpenAI, Hugging Face, and free LLMs.
   - Resume scoring, document Q&A, voice cloning, and AI video generation (SadTalker).
3. **Lead Generation & Outreach Tools:**
   - Google Maps scrapers, website quality analyzers, and bulk WhatsApp number checkers.
   - Multi-channel outreach via WhatsApp Cloud API, Gmail SMTP, and LinkedIn.
4. **Enterprise Systems (CRM + ERP + Delivery):**
   - Full-stack custom software built with FastAPI + React.
   - Automated delivery tracking, job application CRMs, and social media schedulers.

## Our Tech Stack & Capabilities
- **Data:** Python (Pandas), SQL, Power BI, DAX, XGBoost, Random Forest.
- **AI/ML:** LLMs, Gradio, Streamlit, Hugging Face Spaces, Coqui XTTS, SadTalker.
- **Full Stack:** FastAPI (Backend), React + Vite (Frontend), PostgreSQL, Docker.
- **Automation:** WhatsApp Business API, Baileys, Node.js sidecars, OAuth integrations.

## Who We Help
- **SMEs & Startups:** Who are drowning in Excel and need automated dashboards.
- **Agencies & Sales Teams:** Who need automated lead generation and WhatsApp outreach.
- **HR & Recruitment:** Who need AI-powered resume screening.
- **Real Estate & Retail:** Who need interactive property/sales analytics.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Can you build a custom dashboard for my business?** Yes. We build interactive Power BI dashboards that connect directly to your data sources (Excel, SQL, CRM) for real-time insights.
- **Do you offer WhatsApp automation?** Yes, we build custom outreach systems using the official WhatsApp Business API and QR-based automation for bulk messaging and lead tracking.
- **Are you a freelancer or an agency?** NextGen Analytics is a specialized agency led by Muhammad Affaf. You get agency-level quality and end-to-end delivery with the direct communication of a solo founder.
- **What is your delivery time?** We focus on fast delivery. MVP development (like a dashboard or basic AI tool) typically takes 1-2 weeks.
